messages:
ops_lead: Postmortem INC-2027 published. Main ask: turn findings into runbook/playbook updates + assign owners for remediation + timeline. Recurring KV eviction pattern noted. Who takes what? Link: https://redwood.in/p/INC-2027

maria: I9ll take runbook edits. Will add clear triage steps, exact commands, and an escalation flow. ETA: Tue EOD.

ajay: I'll handle autoscaler headroom fixes and a canary change. Will gather metrics and open PR by Fri.

sasha: On alerting - I'll tune thresholds and add a weekly aggregation to spot repeats without paging.

devon: Dropped a quick triage snippet in temp doc, @maria pls pull in.

```bash
# triage: check evictions + mem
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference -c runtime --since=10m | grep -i eviction
redis-cli INFO memory | grep used_memory_human
curl -s 'http://metrics/api/v1/query?query=rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])'
```

maria: Adding fallback trigger (POST /v1/deployments/{id}/fallback) and oncall message template.

sam: I'll prototype a warmup job to run before expected bursts, filing INC-2027-FW-1 and linking.

incident-bot: INC-2027 follow-ups created and reminders scheduled for owners.

ops_lead: Parent Jira INC-2027-FW created. Please attach sub-tasks and PR links. Weekly status required until closure. Tag this thread when PRs are up.

maria: Will tag PRs when ready.

ajay: Found similar traces in previous incidents; adding cross-incident note in playbook.

ops_lead: Thanks team 9 keep updates concise in Jira and tag here for visibility.
